question: Where was Swami Mahavir born?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Kundagram**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mahavira was born in the year **540 B.C.**
 
• He was born in a place called **Kundagrama, near Vaishali** in present-day Bihar.
 
• Mahavira grew up as a **prince.**
 
• According to the researchers, his parents were lay devotees of** Parshvanatha.**
 
• He was the founder of Jainism.
 
• **Jainism:**
 
 
• Jainism, often called Jain Dharma, is a **religion practised in India**.
 
• Jainism links its philosophical underpinnings and historical development through the succession of **twenty-four tirthankaras** (ultimate Dharma lecturers).
 
• **Jain monks** take five fundamental vows: **ahimsa** (non-violence), **satya** (truth), **asteya **(not stealing), **brahmacharya **(chastity), and **aparigraha **(non-possessiveness) after entering the sublime condition of soul consciousness.
 
• One of the **oldest religions** that is still practised today is jainism.
 
• **Digambaras and** **Śvētāmbaras,** two important ancient sub-traditions, have opposing perspectives on ascetic practises, gender, and the writings that are regarded as canonical.
